description: The `button-label-under-upper-case-names` case with its label bound: `[attr.VALUE]="'Send'"`. The tree names the input `VALUE`, as written, and `setAttribute` gives the submit button the `value` it shows (measured through ngc in partial mode, the linker and a render in jsdom). A binding visit that asks `speaks` alone, without the tag and `type` a written attribute is asked with, lets the label through. The package entry carries the one pair the linker writes, `TYPE`, which does not speak, so point 2 does not compare it.
